name: intezaam
description: Intezaam (इंतज़ाम) — a GenAI planning assistant for Indian weddings, birthdays and community events. Deterministic engines compute budgets, timelines, vendor checklists and permissions from your context; Gemini parses briefs and personalises ideas.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @intezaam/web && npm run build -w @intezaam/server
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @intezaam/server" "npm run dev -w @intezaam/web"
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test -w @intezaam/core && npm run test -w @intezaam/server && npm run test -w @intezaam/web
scripts.test:server: npm run build:core && npm run test -w @intezaam/server
scripts.test:web: npm run build:core && npm run test -w @intezaam/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:core && npm run test:coverage --workspaces
scripts.type-check: npm run build:core && npm run type-check --workspaces && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit
scripts.verify: npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
